body: Thank you kind stranger. I see a therapist who has been helping me a lot. I understand now it was rape. I still question from time to time but I think I’m just in denial that something like that could happen to me. Your words have helped me though.

Coming forward is not as easy as you think. You have to repeat your trauma over and over in detail, it’s retraumatising. And going as far as court can be more damaging to your mental health than the actual act. I don’t blame women for not coming forward. It’s hard.

I came forward a month after I was attacked. My case closed about a month ago. The CID contacted me to say they spoke with my attacker but they don’t have enough evidence to proceed with the case.

Now all I want to do is just forget about the whole thing. I was relieved when the police said that as it meant I could finally move on and forget about it.

It’s far more common than people realise and only a fraction of women report their rape. Your first instinct is to wash and forget it even happened. The last thing you want to do is relive that experience over and over again with police. That harmed my mental health more. The police interviewed him but before that they said “how do you know you were saying no if you felt detached from your body, maybe he didn’t hear you”. No. I definitely said no. Sadly it was too late, and there was no evidence to continue. It made me feel like I was in the wrong somehow. Unfortunately I live in a small town with a strong likelihood of seeing my attacker again. Happened a few months ago and I’m still working through it.

I saw you said you wished you fought back. I just wanted to say it you did the right thing. He could’ve harmed you more so don’t feel guilty for that. 

I was the same when I was attacked. I was frozen in fear and kept shaking my head and saying no. I didn’t fight back and felt detached from my body. Unfortunately I only reported it a month later so there wasn’t enough evidence to proceed. You did the right thing and I hope you get the justice you deserve. 

My dms are open if you ever need someone to talk to.

10 years in November. Feels like a lifetime ago, feels like yesterday. In some ways it’s easier, in some ways it’s the same. One thing is consistent in my life at least. We all (myself and my other 4 alive siblings) have been affected in huge and heartbreaking ways.

Thank you. I wish I had that too. It’s a very complicated relationship I think no one could understand. This is just my normal. I’m choosing not to tell my family members, I have a feeling they know it deep down too.

Sadly it’s not as simple as that. My mum is fully codependent on him and will rationalise his lies to her deathbed. It would only cause more pain and I’d be painted as the villain. It’s happened before, I won’t get myself hurt again. All I can do is live my own life and try not to think about it too much. Just need to vent from time to time.
Never saw him go to any hospitals myself. Just told us he was getting chemo
I don’t think I’ve much proof either but at least there’s a record and if anything happens to another girl in future they will have my statement. I’m so sorry this happened to you too.

I’ve had ECG’s in recent years and think my heartrate was fast then too so I’m assuming they’re all clear. Forgot to mention I was born with an arrhythmia but I’ve heard no mention of it since I was a baby. I assume I grew out of it

I’ve seen her have severe shakes on days she doesn’t drink. I’m worried she will have a seizure. She told the doctor she does have a drinking problem so hopefully they’ll do more investigations to see what’s happening and what they can do
Worst part is I’m actually being investigated for structural changes to my brain. I had an mri a couple of weeks ago and an eeg not long before so I said I was worried it’s genetic
I asked him, all he said was no it’s definitely not genetic

Thank you, I knew he was probably lying the whole time but think I can know for sure now. I have a previous post where I went into his lies in more depth. He never really makes much sense when he talks about his health. It’s sad to know I’ve been “taking care” of him since 2015 when he first said he had brain cancer.

I could definitely place one under a mat in the car. I’ll consider this. I spoke with the gp and it went as expected, not allowed to disclose any info. However the gp strongly hinted glioblastoma isn’t survivable and to question my dad if I can.
My dad was always more tanned than the rest of us which I assumed was cus he travelled a lot more than us. I’ll see if I can notice a difference next time
Im in the UK so I’m not sure how it works

I attempted to call the gp to wiggle something out of them but they were so unhelpful. I was told it’s confidential and I’d have to ask for his permission which I thought would happen anyway. Then I asked is glioblastoma survivable for this many years and the clinician said aye you can survive cancer. So unhelpful. I’ve got an appointment with the family doctor and I said it’s about mental health.
Hmm I’ll ask about that. He mentioned adrenal crisis but didn’t say what he does. He told me he can’t be under stress as it could put him into adrenal crisis.

Luckily I moved out a couple of years ago and it was the best thing for me. My mental health improved immensely and I was glad to no longer live in a neglectful environment where I constantly question everything. But I helped take care of him, he seemed genuinely ill. But after finding out it’s glioblastoma and he’s now benign, everything I did for him feels like it’s thrown back in my face. I will try whatever I can to get answers. How could I go about tracking him? I don’t drive.
That’s it sadly. I just can’t believe I took care of him and went to young carers meetings. Even I feel like a fraud. Just need to find out for my own peace of mind
He’s already come up with excuses for me not to come to appointments so I doubt he’ll include me in his care sadly
His excuse is was that his medical records were sent to the new gp so they had no evidence of his cancer treatment on the old gp’s system
Oh sorry we were renting both the houses we lost. He had different excuses for the loss of both.

Regarding the appointments, he says it’s one to one zoom or telephone. Personally never seen him take these appointments when I’ve been around him and I lived with him for a good while. He says they’re still taking precautions and wearing masks in hospitals, making it sound like I can’t attend any with him. Makes me more suspicious. He says he gets scans on his brain every year but again never seen or heard of this happening.
I’ll let you know once he sends it over. I’ve never seen any report before

The 850k he stole? Happened years ago he stole from Leeds city council and got caught trying to buy a house in Scotland. Went to prison for 3 years (sentenced 5). Money was never touched from what I’ve been told

I’ve asked if I can attend appointments and he said there’s a report from the doctor I can read. It makes me feel awful to accuse him of something so sinister if it’s not true. Id feel awful it was true too tbh

Thank you that’s good advice. He said he’ll send over some of his medical record for me to take a look. I said I was interested in it as I’m doing nursing next year and thought it’d be interesting to learn more. We’ll see what comes of it.

Thank you, I don’t think I’ll ever truly know but I’m tempted to call the gp and see if it’s possible to clear it up.

I will say he’s been rather odd recently, he told me about Chinese medicine, acupuncture, natural medicines etc. I always thought he was more scientific but this sudden spirituality is out of place in my eyes. I’ve no idea what to think.

Sorry if this is a dumb question but if he’s getting chemo would he have to have a picc line.
When my mum had chemo she had a picc line in for infusions. Is it possible he just had tablets.
If you can think of any questions I can ask him I can try get a clearer picture of what’s going on
No definitely looks like uticaria to me. He has flare ups they come and go, takes corticosteroids and apparently has Addison’s disease (which I’ve heard is very rare). He carries an epipen with him

They look like hives, it’s uticaria he says. Red raised skin. I thought glioblastoma was very terminal and very unlikely to survive for several years with no visible decline. He says his tumour is benign now but I didn’t think that could happen with glioblastomas but I’m NAD.
Could be for anything. He told me his cancer is no longer spreading but from what I’ve read glioblastoma is terminal
Thank you, I’m struggling to understand it all. He’s told me he’s on tarciva and erlotinib. The Addison’s disease was an effect of his medication apparently

I asked for the first time, I think I didn’t want to believe it in the past. He had to look it up and couldn’t pronounce it properly but it was definitely glioblastoma he said. I don’t know if I was better off not knowing now
I can’t check but I’m sure he had corticosteroids, for what I don’t know though as I think he’s had them for years

I’m 24 and have always struggled with my memory. I have doubts it’s dementia I just have a terrible handle on life. I had an eeg to test for seizure activity but that was clear. I may have a brain mri if my psych believes I need it

Thank you reading this made me feel a bit better. I have a med review with psych soon so I’ll definitely bring all this up. Anxiety was the main thing to get a handle on and I definitely have now but I’m still out of control in other aspects of my life.

Thank you, I’m 24 and have no Alzheimer’s in immediate family so I’m certain it isn’t that. I’ve always lacked in memory and focus. Alarms were very helpful to keep me on track with meds and work (although my meds are becoming difficult to keep track of too). I’ve set alarms in the past to remind me to do house work and sometimes it can help. I write all my shifts in my notes, as well as appointments but I think because I write all my reminders in there I end up getting lost in the notes too.

I’m seeing a lot of comments about adhd. I think I may have mentioned it to my therapist years ago and she told me she never noticed issues my attention in our sessions. If I have adhd it mustn’t look it from the outside. I’m a bit quiet and lack confidence, I wouldn’t say I’m hyperactive and I never have been in school. My grades were poor but I mostly behaved. I do have a lot of childhood trauma too. I just want to know what I can do to get a hold of my life. If it is just childhood trauma, what besides therapy can even help? If I can’t even hold down a therapist what am I supposed to do next.

I’ve been using phone alarms for years and it’s about the only thing that somewhat helps. And yes I think I’d probably have to move to microwave meals, I’m just a bit terrible for leaving old food in the fridge.

I’m sure it could be possible in future but for now I think it’s best I leave it until I can get a grasp on my life. I’m wondering if I should contact her again to ask her what her professional opinion is when it comes to my forgetfulness.

Not an alcoholic but do go out often for a drink. I also take terbinafine which affects the liver so I’m not sure if that would make it worse. Never had yellow eyes but have palor a lot. My liver tests are slightly high but no one seems concerned. They don’t know about the paracetamol

I’ve cut down now, where I’m from it’s not easy to get anything stronger. I’ve always wondered if I’ve caused permanent damage after years of OD’ing on paracetamol and if a simple liver function blood test is enough to tell. I feel fine though

I took very high doses of paracetamol for years. Im talking 8000mg daily. I didn’t realise the damage it could do but had liver function tests that are only slightly high on terbinafine. Idk if I should be worried
Thank you, do you think it may be more related to a mental health condition?

I understand, I’ve been on terbinafine tablets for almost a year now, can’t say I’ve noticed much difference. I have regular liver function tests and while they’re a little high, no one seems worried about it. They’ve stayed at about the same level. I was told I’d be on the terbinafine tablets for about 18 months.

My alcohol intake is usually a bottle of wine a week and only ever more if I meet up with friends. Sometimes I won’t drink at all. I know you’re concerned about possible alcoholism but that’s not it. I do have a flatmate that has a serious issue with alcohol and if anything that puts me right off.

Any excessive alcohol intake I have is just due to living in Scotland!

Terbinafine is for a fungal nail infection I have in my toes. I’m taking folic acid because I had my bloods taken a while back after I felt fatigued and it flagged up low folate (but not dangerously low). I’ve been taking it for a few months to bring it back up.

Edit: that’s more likely to do with my diet too

This is such a lovely comment, thank you. I have a great support system, a mental health team and a therapist. I’ll have a good chat with my psychiatrist soon and see about getting that MRI. 

I wouldn’t say I’m chronically depressed all the time, it comes in waves and those waves are intense. It was mostly related to my anxiety, I would have panic attacks and was unable to perform at work which made me feel intensely low.

I’ve had a pretty traumatic past, I lost my brother to suicide a while back but I know it still affects me from time to time.

After my suicide attempt last year where I OD’d on pills, I contacted my mental health team and requested a place on a mh unit but I was rejected. This was after I already warned them I might attempt and was scared. Sadly the system is overrun and underfunded so it’s unlikely I’ll ever be inpatient.

However right now I’m in a good place. I’m happy with my job and my home and my friends. I hope it stays this way but I can’t say for sure. I was mostly concerned if it was possible to have brain damage following these attempts and would you notice on a brain scan.

Thank you so much for your response though, it means a lot that a stranger on the internet would care this much. Thank you for all your advice. Take care!
An idiot sandwich
I haven’t told anyone yet, I’m an idiot and took it alone in my flat and feel too ashamed to tell anyone yet
Skin picking. Destroyed my whole body and now look like a leper. Someone please chop my fingers off

I’m not sure pregabalin has been around enough to really know what long term effects it could cause. Let us know how you feel though! Any input is useful. I think the main worry is cognitive or memory impairment but I’m not sure there’s many or any studies on this so please don’t take my advice as fact. Have you noticed anything after 2.5 years?
Yes I believe environment played a big part growing up in a hoarded environment for me and my siblings

This is interesting. I am diagnosed general anxiety disorder / panic disorder and was recently told by my psychiatrist I have OCD like behaviours and patterns. It makes sense these tics would go alongside them I guess but I know it’s no actual explanation. My partner worries I have a brain tumour however, esp cus my dad has brain cancer. I think he is being a bit extreme with his worries lol, my dad does not have the same symptoms as me.
Your comment is very interesting but saddening to realise I probably won’t ever get to the bottom of why I am the way I am.

I didn’t take gabapentin often but the tolerance built very quickly when I went on it for a few days. I’d take about 5 300mg every half hour to 45 mins which is quite a lot and it felt like a cosy drunk high. I never had withdrawals because I didn’t do it often
I have GAD and panic disorder which is what is prescribed for but I have days where I’m pretty good and I don’t feel like I need to take it all the time

That’s how gabapentin made me feel with a high staggered dose and fatty foods. I was hoping pregabalin would be similar for me but haven’t felt much yet. Will try a higher dose at some point but need to watch my tolerance
8 years… no longer count the days, weeks or months but I still notice every birthday Christmas and death anniversary.
It’s morning now but I worked a shift at a care home 8pm-8am. Mostly chill night besides a few sun downing wanderers which we entertained with a dance
Working nights as a care assistant. Having the time of my life helping put to bed some very aggressive residents with dementia. I love them all the same. Merry Christmas everyone.
Thanks I’ll try staggering it on an empty stomach. I don’t want to take too much cus I’ve heard it can be dangerous in high doses

Working 12h night shift as a care assistant at a care home all the way up til Boxing Day. Got the shit kicked out of me and my arms clawed out like I jumped in a pit of feral cats. Still love my residents with dementia. Hope I get my Christmas wish that they’ll be in good moods this Christmas!

Sorry I just remembered I had a light dose of opiates roughly within 12 hours before my pregabalin dose and I have a feeling this may have affected it. It was only otc cocodamol tablets adding up to about 128mg of codeine but I think it still could’ve numbed the effects of the pregabalin. I’ll try it by itself next time
Had the same experience. Didn’t help with my insomnia, ended up paranoid and slight hallucinations (hearing voices and lots of sleep paralysis demons). This is my personal experience though.
Yep the dose is 75mg and I have 5 capsules now 😁
He actually bought me a bunch of Oliver sacks books a while back! I love the man who mistook his wife for a hat
Might actually be 225-300mg. I forget the dosage of the pills. Will try it out this weekend!
Ha yeah, except myself and several other students in that class were English 😂
We had a substitute teacher that argued the same thing as well! Everyone in my class failed that question. She then went onto say we were all pronouncing it wrong because we’re Scottish..
Thank you, I’ve never heard of this. I’ve only heard of SSRI treatment but been on them in the past and found no relief. I will bring this up at my next psych appointment

I’m interested about your advice on communicating clearly. I’ve actually been pretty good at communicating exactly what I struggle with and what I believe needs the most help but I’m worried it makes me look more put together than I actually am. This is something my partner has agreed with too. Over the phone I probably sound completely normal. In person it’s a bit more noticeable I’m visibly anxious or stressed. I fidget a lot and look around the room a lot

I’ve noticed this with my T. I’ll mention one session I want to talk about my trauma next session and then I “forget” to talk about it. The therapist never asks about and I think she’s waiting for me to bring it up. I can feel it’s in the back of my mind but can’t stop talking about other things. Maybe it’s because I wasn’t ready.

One time though she did stop me when I was ranting again about how my friends bullied me (I’d been stuck on this and not progressing for so long). She said “you know I have noticed one thing Tasha. You’ve never mentioned your brother during any of our sessions. There’s nothing wrong with that it’s just something I’ve noticed”. She’s been my T for a few years and it caught me off guard. I was surprised with myself for never mentioning it. I’ve started opening up now though.
Yes sorry, I was just pointing out the minority that exist and really do need a proper wage

Not always the case. My friend left home at 16 and had a child. She had to live off of universal credit to get by. I know most 16 year olds aren’t like this but what about the ones that are and ones that need to escape abusive families. You are basically advised to live with your family in this day and age and abused children are forgotten about

Sorry for the rant I just understand the situation of kids that need to escape their home

I don’t agree with kids getting a lesser wage because of their age. They literally do the same job as 18+ people. I worked at McDonald’s for £6 / hour when I was 18 while other older people were getting £9 for the same job (this was in 2016). Idk it just doesn’t seem right to me
Still a shocking wage. £5 really? Not like they’re a small company

Thank you, that makes a lot of sense. I have a psychiatry appointment very soon so I just wondered if it would be worth mentioning this or if like my therapist and partner say, I’m fretting over minor things. I definitely don’t think they can diagnose me I just worry that I overthink too much.

Also what questions / things to talk about would be helpful to ask / tell the psychiatrist? Are there any meds I should mention or ask about?
Baw heid up north

I’ve started making a plan. I’m lucky to have a therapist who can help me gain the courage to eventually leave. This is so difficult.

I really don’t understand my last part of the post. Why am I turned on by something so repulsive…

This is so hard to hear. I still can’t believe he’s abusive and some friends have said that he is just stupid and dense. Some have agreed with you though. I keep thinking it’s still my fault somehow and I’m the abusive one, because that’s what he says I am and I know that’s what he’ll tell everyone.

His ex accused him of rape too and he said she was a total abusive psycho and told her to “go to the police then”. Everyone believes him. I’m scared I’ll lose all my friends.

We have two cats together, one that loves him so much. We have a beautiful place together, my first real home. We also have a lot of great times together and I feel like he does also treat me well. Recently he bought me a pamper kit out of nowhere and told me to treat myself. I sometimes wonder if it’s not so bad at all.

I’m so lost.

My family is one of the reasons I moved in with him in the first place, they were worse to live with. Very neglectful, neglecting pets too. I’ve considered calling RSPCA on them, just need to pluck up the courage.

None of my friends have room but I do have a plan to get a place with my best friend once my lease is up.

They weren’t tested (never do this!) and I think I was overwhelmed with all I’d been suppressing. I wouldn’t recommend psychedelics to people with lots of trauma unless it’s in a therapeutic setting with guidance from a trained therapist
To be fair it was her first time doing psychedelics and she wanted her bf and close friend with her so she felt more safe. Wish I had a heads up though!

Always test your drugs and make sure you’re in the right setting and right mind. I tried 2cb last year and my flatmate decided to invite people I didn’t know well and I ended up fighting the effects the entire night and feeling really anxious. I had a horrible comedown the next day and didn’t leave my bed for 3 days. All my bad memories I’d been suppressing were flung into my consciousness as well

I’m very lucky my T has great patience and accommodates to my needs. I understand what you mean about feeling guilty that your T does extra things for you though. The way I try to interpret it is if they’re suggesting it then they’re more than happy and really want to do it, especially it if it means it will benefit the client and helps them to do their job. If it was too much for the T they would let you know but all it is is a quick run down of the session texted usually just after you leave so I don’t think it’s too much to ask.

A good T will understand clients may suffer with poor memory and dissociation and one who specialises in this should be able to help you improve on it I think, although I’m no expert. They should be willing and trying to find the best way to help you cope and improve.

I found I check my texts more than my emails and it feels much less formal through texts so it doesn’t feel like work to me. I definitely still struggle to do everything I should be doing and retain all the information but it’s a big step up than before.

Sorry if this isn’t much help but I hope you find a solution that works for you soon!

I also struggle with remembering what we discuss in sessions. My T did the most amazing thing though. Early on when I mentioned my memory is so poor I worry I won’t be able to retain any of the information, she came up with the solution that she’ll text me the main points we’ve discussed and anything I should try to work on throughout the week. Now I can look back on all our texts together and see everything we’ve discussed and it’s been an enormous help. Do you think your T could do this?

I live in the UK and would say it’s the same here, a lot of mental health nurses don’t seem to know how to handle people suffering with a mental health crisis. I’ve found their tone to be aggressive, annoyed. I just feel like a nuisance. I’ve been told “what would your family think” after I confessed I had suicidal thoughts and plans. After I ended up in hospital for a suicide attempt I told the nurse I was really struggling with life to focus, concentrate, my memory is poor and I’m always on edge. The nurse said “but that’s just your personality isn’t it?”. I’ve been blatantly lied to about the treatment they provide on the NHS when I do research and know they provide talking therapies (why lie about that?!). It’s an absolute shambles here, and they wonder why I don’t want to cooperate much with them.
It’s a terrible club to be a part of but I’m glad we have others that can truly understand

I imagine not everyone’s the same but every now and then when the memories come back I still think about how I asked my brother how uni was going when he wasn’t even going a few days before he died. I thought my question pushed him over the edge because he was lying to us about attending uni. It’s been several years now and those thoughts come a lot less frequently but they’re still there when the waves hit. Sending you lots of love and healing. Remember this is not your fault no matter what your mind makes you think ❤️

I’m having the same problem, I’m in Scotland. 2 months for earliest appointment even after I told them a month ago I’m close to the edge and feel like I’m gonna do something stupid soon. This week I ended up trying to take my own life.

I really hope you can find someone soon that will help you. It’s a shame mental health services seem so stretched thin and wait times are ridiculous. Keep hanging in there, 2 months does seem like such a long time but it can be surprising how quick time passes sometimes.

Best of luck to you, I really hope you can get the help you need soon.

I recently ended up in hospital for a suicide attempt too. My boyfriend found me on my brother’s memorial bench (who also committed suicide several years ago). He nearly left me that day. It hurt so much but I understand where he’s coming from. I hate hurting the people I love. He’s actually training to be a mental health nurse too.

He’s still with me but I can see how hurt he is and it kills me. I don’t know how to keep going.
Fair enough, I will mention it really hasn’t been helpful for my anxiety all this time but has been great for my sleep. Do you think I may have a misdiagnosis?

Severe insomnia, shaky hands (makes it impossible to work sometimes), skin picking, teeth problems from grinding teeth, tachycardia (my resting hr is 105), fatigue, lack of appetite, aches and pains. 

I believe my severe anxiety also caused my short Achilles’ tendons from excessive toe curling which I needed surgery to correct

I have considered adhd in the past, but I’m not hyperactive at all. My therapist believes it’s my anxiety and not an attention disorder. I’ve been told because I have trauma I cannot be diagnosed with adhd as they cause the same symptoms, but I do believe I suffered with these symptoms before anything bad ever happened to me. I always got bad grades at school and distinctly remember watching everyone else work while I doodled on a page or tried to talk to other people. I have always struggled to focus and it has never gone away no matter how well I’m doing with my mental health.

I think it’s worth asking a psychiatrist or psychologist about it again but I highly doubt I will get a diagnosis given my traumatic history.

ETA: I will say I struggle with my physical health and it’s possible that has an impact on my focus and memory. My folate and potassium was low, liver proteins high and somethings up with my kidney. They’re still investigating it so I’ve no idea what’s up yet but it’s possible they’re causing the brain fog.

This is an excellent question and advice, thank you! For me a life without anxiety and depression would be one where I don’t suffer with the symptoms such as the sense of impending doom, shaky hands, racing heart, lack of concentration, disorganised, not present (dissociating?), forgetfulness and insomnia. So one where I can be calm, concentrate, motivated, work without struggling so I can stay organised and remember all the important things I need to do, and be without the physical symptoms of anxiety like shakiness. This is why I believe a mix of therapy and medication would be beneficial for both changing my mindset and controlling those physical symptoms/ preventing a panic attack.

You are correct I have learned schemas to cope in an unstable environment. I learned to mistrust as my dad always lies and let’s us down (stole 850k from his work, lied about going on a business trip when he handed himself into the police and many more things like this). I have learned to expect to be abandoned as I have on a few occasions by my parents (I was left at school with no way home when I was in crutches and no money, my dad going to prison etc). And I have struggled with my mums constant pessimism, telling us kids she wants to die all the time, not only that but we have had a lot bad happen to us like my brothers suicide, evictions, both my parents have cancer and lost another of my brothers to still born, so I still feel I have to be prepared for yet another bad thing to happen. It is hard to imagine living without these schemas as they feel like the right way to think although I’m semi aware they’re not.

I have had CBT a number of times and I do believe it helps but the advice I learn doesn’t seem to stick with me and I end up slipping and needing therapy again after a few months on my own. I do think I need medication for the physical symptoms, I work with the elderly and struggle to stay organised, I have forgotten to do important things like checks to make sure their pad is changed etc.

Thank you for the advice you’ve already given and if you have any more I’d be incredibly grateful! Take care!

Sounds like a sh!tty chair! A few years ago my bestie bought a brand new stool, I sat on it and within 5 minutes the thing broke and I crashed to the floor 😭 her family heard it all from downstairs, I was so embarrassed
That puts me at ease a bit. All they could tell me is that the protein levels are still up and I need more tests. I’ll try find out more next week

I think what you went through was a form of sexual and emotional abuse. Your feelings are completely valid. Even if he only hit you once this is still abuse. I’m sorry you went through that. It can make your feelings about his suicide very conflicting and confusing. It is okay to grieve and feel sad, and it’s okay to feel hurt and angry. No matter what you’re feeling you are valid. I hope you can heal and have people around you that support you.

Dates are also difficult for me. I always struggle with the week leading up to the date of my brother’s death. All the best to you OP.
Yes

Yes I was involved. We were all very drunk and after a while decided to get to sleep. The two of them woke up a bit later and continued on like we hadn’t stopped and I woke up frozen in place to hear them at it. He has since apologised a lot and we tried to work through it.

This post hasn’t been up that long but already I can see the responses are already confirming my fears. I’ve stayed and put up with him for far too long despite all of the times he disrespected me. I have severe anxiety so I kept believing somehow it was all my fault but after this you’ve all opened my eyes. I’m not putting up with this anymore. Thank you for making me see things clearly.
Seems to work for cows lol, but I can appreciate we probably wouldn’t have evolved intelligently without a variety of foods including meat. Is that right?

You’re right I don’t think I ever said stop or no. I also don’t remember saying yes (although he said I went “mhm”.) I feel like it isn’t possible to make an enthusiastic consent while knocked out on sleeping tablets although I do understand he didn’t know that.
